name: 1616-1620 S. Prairie Avenue — the alley building of the house at 1620 (district draft; refined by T-1932)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'long 2-storey brick building on the alley, unmarked (no stable X), behind the vacant frontage'. Carried as standing in 1904: no source dates it after 1904, and it is the rear of the lot the 1886 plate shows built.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2334, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1932 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 20 trace (s20fp-1616_1620-b1), the T-1840 census (s20-1620-r1) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20-006; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-16-18-west-2334).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1840 census rules it present in 1904 (backcast_1886). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 1616-1620 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_1616_1620 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 16th to 18th Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 0.250, v -11.500 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check, so its own fit residual, 2.46 m RMS on its control crossings, is all that is claimed. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: The Robert Law house restored for 1904 (the register's 'irregular earlier brick envelope across lots 13-14, projecting bay, arched windows, stoop, bounded roof'): the plate's L read as the main body and its shallower south part, under a low hip. Its stable on the alley is the sheet's own long two-storey brick building. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 382399607 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
